H2_calibration.quote: A joint resolution requires presentment to the President, so it is simply a new law; Congress could always lift the ban by statute anyway. The provision adds nothing legally while implying a procedural hurdle that does not exist.
H2_calibration.note: Also item 34: the vaguer the prohibition, the easier the defense; item 32 flags retroactive liability as raising due-process problems.

H4_grandfather_step.quote: A run started the day before enactment can continue indefinitely, and a developer who launches a nominal run before signing could later argue the full-scale run is a continuation of it.
